technique: Exclusive `<details name>` laid out as tabs
notes: An exclusive `<details>` group gives you focusable tabs with a real expanded state and no hidden radios. With `display: contents`, every `<summary>` joins one grid row and its `::details-content` fills the row below.

Honest caveat: HTML still has no tabs element. Screen readers hear disclosure buttons, arrow keys do not move between tabs, and full ARIA tabs still need a little script. Older browsers show a plain accordion.
